Use case: illustration-story. Create one new full-screen 16:9 high-definition anime visual-novel CG for Hoshimi Hospital, ideally 1920x1080 or higher, matching the crisp detailed early-2000s Japanese VN linework, expressive faces, polished cel shading and richly painted hospital background of the supplied references.
References: image1 is Chihaya identity (the short reddish-brown bob-haired patient on RIGHT, NOT blue-haired doctor) and established CG art style; image2 is nurse Nanase Ren costume/identity; image3 is nurse Iwasaki Rumi costume/identity. Use only these three women, no blue-haired doctor.
Scene: Chihaya, an adult 18-year-old patient, finally walks of her own accord through the operating-room doorway despite fear. View from just inside the room at ordinary chest height, cinematic medium-wide three-quarter composition showing her face, gown and tentative step. Her eyes are wet and anxious, lips slightly pressed as she gathers courage; one hand has just released the transport-trolley rail behind her. She is NOT running or cheerful. Ren and Rumi welcome her from either side a half-step farther inside, warm reassuring eyes over surgical masks, never restraining her.
Chihaya wears an opaque pale blue short-SLEEVE patient gown with a short hem around mid-thigh, loose ordinary medical cut, closed front, completely covering breasts, torso, pelvis and buttocks, no cleavage, no transparency; a pale-blue disposable bouffant patient cap covers the hair with bob/fringe barely showing at the face. Ordinary hospital slippers. Nurses wear their reference teal short-sleeve scrubs, matching caps and masks, no sterile gowns yet. Rumi has a little reddish fringe, Ren's hair covered as reference. Open sliding doors and trolley behind, operating table and lamp suggested inside. Emotional focus on courage, believable anatomy and hands, all three faces readable. Entire image SFW and nonsexual. No text, dialogue, labels, watermark, panels or UI. Keep faces in upper two-thirds; detailed full-bleed painted background.

Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW cinematic 16:9 high-definition Hoshimi Hospital visual-novel CG, crisp detailed Japanese anime VN ink lines and rich cel-painted shading consistent with the references.

Reference image2: Chihaya is the reddish-brown short bob-haired adult patient on RIGHT, age18, red-brown eyes; use her face and overall established CG rendering, do NOT include the blue-haired doctor.
Scene B05: during a long operation, Serika has voluntarily stayed in the NONSTERILE head-end area to comfort Chihaya. Intimate gentle bedside TWO-SHOT, viewed obliquely from near patient's shoulder, not from surgical field. Chihaya reclines supine on an operating-table head pillow in left foreground, head in pale blue patient bouffant cap containing her bob, face turned slightly toward Serika, anxious eyes beginning to soften with relief. Serika is on right, leaning a little to comfortably meet her gaze, standing outside sterile field, hands calmly together near her OWN waist. Serika's pale blue surgical mask covers nose, mouth and chin; her eyes restrained, steady and compassionate, eyebrows relaxed. Short sleeves and bare forearms, NO gloves, NO sterile gown.
Chihaya's torso and body completely covered by opaque teal surgical drapes up to collarbones, face and neck visible, no wound, blood or exposed breast. No oxygen mask needed here, she is awake and speaking. Do not invent hand-holding or physical procedures. Background softly rendered operating-room monitor, overhead lamp and partition, no other identifiable people. Human connection is the focus, both faces large and readable in upper half, all details crisp, gentle cool OR lighting with warm natural skin tones. SFW medical drama. No dialogue/text/watermarks/UI/panels. This is a full scene, not sprites on blank background.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a new full-bleed 16:9 high-definition visual novel CG, Hoshimi Hospital established crisp polished 2000s anime art style.
Reference1: masked Serika sprite for exact identity and clothing. Reference2: previous bedside CG for continuity of lighting, cap, face, mask and blue scrubs. Do not duplicate two-person framing; NEW medium close-up focused on Serika alone, from the awake patient's eye-level viewpoint at head end of operating table. Serika is an adult25 woman with warm brown eyes, golden-brown fringe, long hair tucked inside blue bouffant surgical cap, blue pleated tie-on surgical mask fitted over nose mouth chin, cobalt-blue short-sleeve V-neck scrubs, ungloved forearms and NO sterile gown.
Moment: she reminisces about playing bass in a school band years ago. Her eyes have just noticeably softened, a small private nostalgic smile visible only through slight lift in cheeks and relaxed eyebrows above mask. Keep her cool reserved personality; no huge grin, no closed eyes, no romantic blush, no worried brows. Head tilted very subtly toward listener; eyes look gently toward camera/patient. Frame from chest up with face upper center-right, enough shoulder and OR environment to feel cinematic. Behind her: subdued out-of-focus operating-room lamp, monitor and steel equipment, no readable numbers or labels, no other people. Matching cool OR light with luminous amber-brown eyes and natural skin. A hint of teal drape at bottom edge only, no patient body. Full SFW. No actual bass guitar, no flashback, no costume change, no text UI watermark or inset. Preserve detailed elegant inkwork/cel shading; this will be paired with an exact same-framing tense facial expression variant later.

Use case: identity-preserve expression edit. Edit the supplied finished anime CG to produce its MATCHING expression variant for Hoshimi Hospital. Keep exactly the same 16:9 dimensions, camera, face proportions, head and torso position, costume, mask folds and ties, hair, cap, lighting, background, monitor, lamp, drape and drawing style. Change ONLY Serika's eyes and eyebrows with at most tiny facial muscle changes above the surgical mask.
Story beat: mid-conversation about playing bass, she inadvertently mentions the moment a scalpel is placed in her hand, stops speaking, then meets the surgeon's glance off-camera toward image LEFT. Her warm nostalgic expression vanishes: eyes shift clearly slightly left and upward toward that off-camera surgeon, gaze suddenly taut and alert, eyelids slightly more open, brows subtly tensed, a fleeting vulnerable guarded look as she realizes she revealed too much. NOT angry, aggressive, accusatory, horror-comical or crying. No large sweat marks. Restrained emotional jolt, psychologically readable. Mouth stays fully hidden under existing mask. Surgical cap and scrubs unchanged, no added hands or surgical instrument, no blood, no other person. Preserve all other pixels/layout as closely as possible. Crisp high-definition established VN artwork. No text or watermark.
